findings.title: push_pr body-file path is quoted, contradicting the task's literal template and the option description it must match
findings.detail: Task 12(C) specifies the exact template line `gh pr create --base {{.Base}} --title '{{.PRTitleQuoted}}' --body-file {{.PRBodyPath}}` (body path unquoted). The diff instead renders `--body-file '{{.PRBodyPathQuoted}}'`, adding a new, unrequested `RunData.PRBodyPathQuoted()` method (internal/brief/brief.go, singleQuoted applied to the body path) not mentioned anywhere in the task. Worse, this creates a real inconsistency with the task's own literal Description text in internal/decide/questions.go (`gh pr create --base <base> --title '<title>' --body-file <path>` — body path deliberately left unquoted per task 12(D)), so the branch_finish option text the deciding session reads no longer matches the command the run-push_pr op actually renders. Task 12(B)'s brief_test.go table entry was likewise changed to a body path containing an apostrophe to exercise the added quoting, deviating from the task's literal `PRBodyPath: "/b/finish/pr.md"` fixture and expected unquoted rendering. This is scope beyond what task 12 asked for in (B)/(C)/(D), executed consistently but not as specified.
